Fire: Do not use elevators during a fire.
Feel the door before opening — if hot, do not open.
Move to the nearest emergency exit stairwell.
Medical: Do not move the person unless they are in immediate danger.
Stay with the person until help arrives.
Security Threat: Remain calm and do not approach the threat.
Move to a safe location if possible.
Flood: Turn off electricity if safe to do so.
Power Outage: Stay where you are if it's safe.
Wait for further instructions from staff.
